Subject: Launch position and decision needed

Avery,

The October 8, 2026 production launch remains tentative and is no longer the working release date. Nia’s security review now completes October 12 at the earliest, and release requires completed approval. The review may require remediation, so no new production date is authorized.

The team can still deliver a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data. That preserves the original demonstration date without treating the product as approved for production.

Please choose whether to accept the staging demo. Once you decide, we will align the schedule with Nia’s review and the required approval.
